title: Tinker Airmen Assist Tornado Victims
description: 600 Airmen from Tinker Air Force Base, Okla., volunteer to assist tornado victims in Moore, Oklahoma May 24, 2013.  An EF-5 tornado devastated the central Oklahoma town May 20, 2013, causing an estimated $2 billion in damage. Soundbites from Col. Steven Bleymaier, Lt. Gen. Bruce Litchfield, Senior Airman William McPhillips, Daniel Garbleman. Available in High Definition.
keywords: tornado, Tinker Air Force Base, Oklahoma, Moore, David Clark, 3rd Combat Camera, oklahoma tornado, Steven Bleymaier, Bruce Litchfield, William McPhillips, Daniel Garbleman, AIr Force, Combat Camera, High Definition, recovery
